mapper.sql: id, course_id, content, question_type, options, correct_answer, analysis, score, difficulty, status, deleted_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM question WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT #{count}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO question (course_id, content, question_type, options, correct_answer, analysis, score, difficulty, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{courseId}, #{content}, #{questionType}, #{options}, #{correctAnswer}, #{analysis}, #{score}, #{difficulty}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
